Change c0529. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): This was my duty; but there was another still paramount to that.

1818 text: My duties towards my fellow-creatures had greater claims to my attention, because they included a greater proportion of happiness or misery.

1831 text: My duties towards the beings of my own species had greater claims to my attention, because they included a greater proportion of happiness or misery.

Diff: My duties towards {+the beings of+} my [-fellow-creatures-] {+own species+} had greater claims to my attention, because they included a greater proportion of happiness or misery.

Context after (unchanged): Urged by this view, I refused, and I did right in refusing, to create a companion for the first creature.

result.rationale: "my fellow-creatures" becomes "the beings of my own species": a diction change with the same referent, humankind. The new phrase slightly stresses species boundaries over shared creaturehood, which fits the creature theme, but the meaning is essentially unchanged.
